facts.fact: NAM-CSIRT operates under the Communications Regulatory Authority of Namibia (CRAN).
NAM-CSIRT issued a warning after the Paratus Namibia breach reported on 19 February 2025, rated Level 3, and CRAN says it is working with Paratus to mitigate it.

systems.country_label: Namibia Cyber Security Incident Response Team (NAM-CSIRT)
